note: Read by snoop-monitor. Each entry tails a tool's output log for `pattern`; a match counts as a signal, and the monitor stays the ONLY thing that fires disk-reclaim. Paths match what the synthetic-logs launcher makes each tool write (start_detector redirects a tool's stdout to <logdir>/service.log; spectre uses its own --log-file). Nothing fires until you (a) build the tool via apps/<name>/install.sh, (b) confirm it actually writes the alerts these patterns match — VERIFY the field names against the tool's real output — and (c) set enabled:true. A pattern that is too broad here wipes your real OS on a false positive.
name: _readme
argus
note: eBPF tracer (C). Launcher runs `argus --json` -> service.log (newline JSON). These event types mean someone is analyzing the running system. VERIFY argus's JSON event-type strings match this pattern.

name: orin
note: Offline forensics/integrity (Python). Launcher runs `orin stream --verbose` -> service.log. Tamper + rootkit indicators. CORROBORATING: package updates cause benign drift, so require a 2nd signal. VERIFY orin's stream output wording.

name: spectre
note: Behavioral HIDS (Python). Launcher runs `spectre run --log-file /var/log/spectre/alerts.log`. CORROBORATING: priv-esc / lineage rules false-positive on ordinary admin, so require a 2nd signal + threshold 2.

name: prx-sd
note: Antivirus (Rust). OFF-TARGET for snoop detection (finds malware, not forensic examiners) and noisy — left disabled AND off in the launcher (RUN_PRXSD=no). If enabled, keep CORROBORATING and match only rootkit indicators.
